The workbook generation failed because expected data matrices in the 'Task' sheet were empty or contained None values.
The verifier failed with an AssertionError in test_lookup_blocks and test_derived_values_and_stats. Specifically, cells in the ranges H12:L17 (top block) and H35:L40 (net metric) returned None instead of the expected numerical values (e.g., H12 expected 612.5, H35 expected 4.499). While the workbook structure was created, the logic for populating these specific data matrices or performing the underlying calculations is missing or incorrectly mapped to the 'Task' worksheet.
